Class Tcp

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.net.tcp.Tcp
public final class Tcp extends Object
Allocation-free TCP transport recognized as compiler intrinsics by Juno.

One TCP connection is available to a Juno program. Open it with an IPv4 endpoint, write a caller-owned request, then read an exact number of response bytes into a caller-owned buffer. Call close() after every exchange. The transport has no protocol knowledge: framing, encoding, and response parsing belong to the Java API layered on top of it.
